To spoof legitimate influence, an attacker must continuously flood every subnet with high-volume synthetic traffic, destroying the fable of zero-cost replication. The per-identity cost is measured in real hardware resource exhaustion and persistent bandwidth waste, turning cheap virtual nodes into an economically jade-heavy burden that collapses under sustained protocol pressure.
